frame_note: Three strand doors only on the surface. Concepts are depth inside strands and internal routing scaffolding — not a nav layer. Typed edges (requires/unlocks/next_to) from Catalog edge table only. related[] from concept row wikilinks filtered to concept targets. strategies_attached from Catalog build-status table. curated_links.bands from _Concept × Band Grid (PhD, 2026-07-28): tagged where Edutopia carries a grade tag; [] where untagged (untagged ≠ cross-grade).

concepts.label: Relationships
concepts.dese_note: QI 5.3 — 'the influence of classroom, school, and community culture on student relationships'; 'Develops a positive culture... to positively affect student relationships and learning'

concepts.label: Belonging
concepts.dese_note: Derived from 5.3 'positive social interaction' and culture language

concepts.label: Engagement
concepts.dese_note: QI 5.1 title — 'Classroom Management, Motivation and Engagement'

curated_links.label: Active-participation routines
curated_links.note: Low-lift structures that pull students into the work rather than waiting for them to self-start.

curated_links.label: Strategies for student autonomy
curated_links.note: Six moves that shift from compliance to investment by giving students real say in how they learn.

concepts.label: Behavior & Redirections
concepts.dese_note: QI 5.1 — 'addresses misbehavior... with the least disruption of instruction'

concepts.label: Repair
concepts.dese_note: Derived from 5.3 'positive culture... student relationships' — RP mechanism for keeping students in community after harm

concepts.label: Expectations & Norms
concepts.strand_label: bridges Behavior & Engagement and Culture & Belonging
concepts.dese_note: Derived — 'expectations' not verbatim in Std 5 but management techniques (5.1) and positive culture (5.3) rest on shared taught expectations

concepts.label: Transitions
concepts.dese_note: QI 5.2 — 'management of time, space, transitions and activities'

curated_links.label: Transition leaders and self-regulation supports
curated_links.note: Reads students who struggle at the seam as having a regulation need rather than a compliance problem, and gives them ownership roles plus sensory/predictability supports to manage the shift.

concepts.label: Routines
concepts.dese_note: Derived from 5.2 scope — repeatable structures that make transitions and activities run

curated_links.label: Voice-and-choice routines
curated_links.note: Routines built around student-led activities so predictability comes from structure students help shape rather than top-down direction.

concepts.label: Feedback
concepts.dese_note: Supporting node — cross-standard (SoL/Std 7); feedback lands on the relationship channel

concepts.label: Physical Space
concepts.dese_note: QI 5.2 — 'Management of Time, Space, Transitions, and Activities' — DESE names space directly

curated_links.label: Student-designed flexible seating
curated_links.note: Flexible seating designed with students rather than for them.

concepts.label: Visual Supports
concepts.dese_note: QI 5.2 (Space) + 5.1 — visual schedules, anchor charts, posted cues are designed information the room carries so the teacher does not have to say it every time

curated_links.label: Student-created visual aids
curated_links.note: Visual aids made by students rather than downloaded — students who build the anchor chart remember what's on it.

sol_supporting.label: Cognitive Load
sol_supporting.note: The mind has a limited workspace; overloading it blocks learning. Predictable structure, clear routines, and one-thing-at-a-time reduce extraneous load so capacity is free for actual learning.
sol_supporting.source: Deans for Impact, SoL 2nd ed. 2026, Q1

sol_supporting.label: Working Memory
sol_supporting.note: The small, limited store where active thinking happens. Automaticity from rehearsed routines frees it for complex work.
sol_supporting.source: Deans for Impact, SoL 2nd ed. 2026, Q1/Q2

sol_supporting.label: Attention
sol_supporting.note: Finite and easily pulled away. Protected by clean transitions and low load; sustaining it is what engagement depends on.
sol_supporting.source: Deans for Impact, SoL 2nd ed. 2026, Q1
